answer: The flour dresser signs the sack of her best flour with a hot iron, so the buyer knows whose hands milled it. Corn meal loaf moulder bolting seal rules the signing: a seal meal loaf moulders renew after moulding bench hearings. The reef is the first sack signed, the island the last before the iron cools, and the opal is the cooling, the iron set back in the coals. A cheat would sign 97 false sacks and cool 97 false irons.
